name: DebateQA
description: DebateQA is a dataset of 2,941 debatable questions, each accompanied by multiple human-annotated partial answers capturing a variety of perspectives. Each question is paired with point-of-view statements and long-form explanations, enabling evaluation of LLMs on inherently controversial and multi-perspective questions.
reputation: Published at EACL 2026; addresses gap in evaluating LLMs on questions with no single correct answer
notes: Two novel metrics: Perspective Diversity (comprehensiveness of viewpoints) and Dispute Awareness (acknowledgment of debatable nature); both align with human preferences; constructed via three-stage semi-automated pipeline with human annotation.
